name: theme-paper
title: Byterygon theme: paper
description: Paper: a warm light theme for reading. Cream backgrounds, a rust accent, larger text with relaxed line height, rounder corners, comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.
